content:
I need to find the exact total penguin population figure stated on English Wikipedia's Penguin article as of the end of 2012.

Please try accessing these URLs and report what you find:
1. https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Penguin&oldid=526504882 (try this revision ID or nearby ones from late 2012)
2. https://web.archive.org/web/20121231000000/http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penguin
3. Search for "penguin population 19 million" or "penguin population 20 million wikipedia"
4. Try visiting https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penguin to see if it has simpler population info

The question specifically asks about "upper estimates" of total penguin population on English Wikipedia at end of 2012. I've heard figures around 18-19 million but need to confirm.

Report the EXACT number and exact wording.
